newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti chief to meet minister Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti chief to meet minister Wednesday.

text.p: Olivetti chief executive Francesco Caio and other senior managers of the information technology group will meet Italian Industry minister Luigi Bersani in Rome on Wednesday, an Olivetti spokesman said.
The meeting will be held on Wednesday evening but a time has not yet been fixed.

Earlier on Monday, Bersani told reporters while attending a conference in Turin that the government wanted to meet Olivetti managers and trades unions in order to evaluate the situation at the troubled company.
Olivetti shares went into freefall on the Milan stock exchange on Monday after a two-day suspension was lifted, forcing exchange authorities to step in again and halt trading.

The crisis-hit group's stock price slid to below 600 lire, triggering an automatic suspension in the afternoon under exchange rules limiting price movements to 20 percent either way, the stock market council said.
Trading failed to start again and dealers said it was now expected to get underway again on Tuesday morning.
